thread_title: S. leucophylla 'pink and white' Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla 'pink and white' Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Here's anew selection of pink leucophylla that has a little bit more white on it than most other clones! Maybe this clone will be a bit more impressive once it reaches vegetative maturity, it's not quite there yet but still, the traits are very distinguishable at this stage. I'll keep this thread updated as the clone matures throughout the coming years.

S. leucophylla 'pink and white' Baldwin Co, AL, pics taken 11/14/23:




Notice the left side has white stretching further down the trap than on the right side...that's because the left side got full sun while the right side was shaded. Light hitting the trap makes a huge difference in the phenotypic expression of Sarracenias in general:
